items.title: iOS builds link again with Swift Package Manager disabled
items.description: Flutter installs plugins as CocoaPods :path pods, and CocoaPods never downloads a podspec's s.source for those. The published podspecs pointed at the TraceletCore / TraceletSyncFFI release archives through exactly that mechanism, so the Rust core was simply absent and an iOS build failed at link time with hundreds of undefined UniFFI symbols — silently, with no warning from pod install. The podspecs now fetch and checksum their own binary when CocoaPods evaluates them, and each links the framework it vendors. Apps on Swift Package Manager, which is the default, were never affected.
